newsitem.title: USA: Damen Financial Q1 net off on higher costs.
newsitem.headline: Damen Financial Q1 net off on higher costs.

text.p: Damen Financial Corp said Tuesday increased operating expenses were a factor in a drop in net income in the first quarter of fiscal 1997.
The company reported net income of $392,000 in the quarter ended December 31, compared to $471,000 a year ago.

Damen Financial officials said an increase in net interest income was more than offset by increased operating expense, primarily increased salaries, bonuses, ESOP compensation and other programs that were not in place a year ago.
Damen Financial is the parent of Damen Federal Bank for Savings. Its shares closed up 1/4 Tuesday at 13-1/2.
